title: VIXEN asset staging must create the stamp parent
body: Fresh queued build failed with exit 2: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent gpulock --resource build --label gpulock:baseline-test-build -- nice -n 10 cmake --build VIXEN/build --target rendergraph_svo_tests --parallel 4. VixenAssets.cmake writes vixen_stage_assets/<hash>.stamp without creating that parent; manual mkdir -p VIXEN/build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets let the retry proceed. Add a stamp-parent directory creation in the staging helper so a fresh build needs no lane setup.

title: Direct CodegenTool runs need shared invariant runtime setup
body: The dispatch-requested direct dotnet restore/build/run --check was executed from the pinned CodegenTool snapshot through the global queue. The VIXEN CMake bootstrap builds with InvariantGlobalization=true and supplies an invariant SDK runtimeconfig; the direct command required manually passing -p:InvariantGlobalization=true and DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 to use that same runtime setup. The tool then ran and exposed a separate AppFlow schema contract error. Publish or share the direct-run wrapper/runtimeconfig so users do not have to reconstruct this host setup by hand.
